name: Brain Drain
body:
School necromancy; Level Magus 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range Touch
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With a spell and a touch you drain some of a targets mental acuity. The target takes 1d6 Intelligence penalty + 1 per 4 levels (max +5). The target gets a Will save to halve the intelligence penalty. This penalty cannot reduce a target below 1 Intelligence. You gain a +1 inherent bonus to Intelligence for every 2 penalty inflicted. This bonus lasts for 1 round per caster level.
